summary: Andos Enda, the federation of eastern groves: a Speaker and a moot, the old rivalry with Herrodon, friendly letters with Sonargur and a watch on the eastern water.

federal_moot.name: The Federal Moot
federal_moot.desc: The moot speaks slowly and loudly, and what it decides is hard to turn.

one_voice.name: One Voice for Andos Enda
one_voice.desc: In time of need the Speaker carries one voice for all five groves.

every_grove.name: Every Grove Its Voice
every_grove.desc: Each grove keeps its voice and its veto, and the federation keeps its peace.

northern_timber.name: Timber for Leren Ships
northern_timber.desc: Fallen timber is sold to the northern yards, and the trade brings goodwill.

stand_apart.name: The Elves Stand Apart
stand_apart.desc: The federation writes warmly to the north and signs nothing.

resin_trade.name: Resin and Timber
resin_trade.desc: Amber and dry timber move down the rivers, though the groves buy less cloth than they used to.

woods_prosper.name: The Woods Prosper
woods_prosper.desc: Shared patterns of craft speed every new building.

eastern_water_watch.name: Watch on the Eastern Water
eastern_water_watch.desc: Watchers on the river heads see every keel on the eastern water.

grove_scouts_spirit.name: Grove Scouts
grove_scouts_spirit.desc: Silent scouts and shuttered lanterns see farther than any host.

federal_host.name: The Federal Host
federal_host.desc: Five groves, one banner, and a host that drills as a single company.

federation_defends.name: The Federation Defends
federation_defends.desc: Every grove is a fortress and every speaker at the walls.

the_federal_moot.title: The Grove-Speakers Meet
the_federal_moot.desc: The grove-speakers of the five eastern groves gather beneath the open sky for the year's first moot. They have agreed on everything except who shall speak first.

slight_remembered.title: A Slight Remembered
slight_remembered.desc: An old grove-speaker rises in the moot and recites, as she does each year, the oldest of Herrodon's offences: a crown set up over free groves. The younger speakers do not ask her to sit down.

andos_enda_asks_judgement.title: Andos Enda Asks for Judgement
andos_enda_asks_judgement.desc: An envoy from Andos Enda stands before the elders of the Magical Forest and asks them to judge the quarrel of the boundary groves. The elders have judged many quarrels, and few so old.

groves_shared.title: The Groves Shared
groves_shared.desc: A herald from Andos Enda brings the Queen of Herrodon an offer she did not expect: the boundary groves held in common, tended by both and claimed by neither. The Queen has never been asked to forgive anyone before breakfast.

focuses.name: The Speakers' Federation
focuses.desc: Five clusters of eastern groves send their grove-speakers to one moot and choose one Speaker from among them. Andos Enda holds no crown and thinks crowns vain, and it has never regretted the habit.

focuses.name: Andosiel's Voice
focuses.desc: Speaker Andosiel carries the moot's word to every grove and brings the groves' word back. The office has no crown, and a good Speaker needs none.

focuses.name: The Grove-Speakers
focuses.desc: Each grove-speaker holds their seat for as long as their grove trusts them. They are not clever men, but they are honest, and the federation has endured on little else.

focuses.name: The Federal Moot
focuses.desc: The moot is given a fixed hall among the eastern trees, with a circle of stumps for seats and a rule that none may speak twice before all have spoken once.

focuses.name: One Voice for Andos Enda
focuses.desc: The groves agree that in times of need the Speaker shall carry one voice for them all. Decisions come faster, and a few grove-speakers grow quiet.

focuses.name: Every Grove Its Voice
focuses.desc: Each grove keeps its own voice and its own veto. The moot is slow, and what it decides is not easily undone.

focuses.name: The Federation Endures
focuses.desc: Five groves, one moot and no crown. Whatever the Federation may lack in splendour, it makes up in endurance.

focuses.name: A Slight Remembered
focuses.desc: An old grove-speaker recites the list of Herrodon's offences before the moot, as she does every year. This year the younger speakers listen.

focuses.name: Remember Every Slight
focuses.desc: The moot resolves that no slight of Herrodon's shall be forgotten. The Queen's crown is remembered as the first of them.

focuses.name: Forgive the Old Slights
focuses.desc: The moot resolves to forgive, slowly and in order, the offences of the western crown. It is a long list, and the Speaker reads it only once.

focuses.name: Answer in Kind
focuses.desc: The federation's archers drill at the edge of the boundary groves, in plain sight of Herrodon's watchers. Nobody draws a bow, and everybody knows what the drill is for.

focuses.name: Seek the Forest's Word
focuses.desc: The Speaker sends an envoy to the Magical Forest to ask whose the boundary groves are. The great forest has judged between elves since before any grove had a name.

focuses.name: The Feud of the Groves
focuses.desc: The moot has decided that the quarrel will no longer be argued, and the federation takes the boundary groves by force. It is meant to be a local war, and the elders say so loudly.

focuses.name: The Groves Shared with Herrodon
focuses.desc: With the quarrel cold, the Speaker offers Herrodon the boundary groves in common: tended by both, owned by neither, and named in no one's boundary-lay.

focuses.name: Letters from Sonargur
focuses.desc: Ships from the north call at the eastern rivers for timber, and the merchants of Sonargur know the grove-speakers by name. The Speaker answers their letters warmly, and signs nothing.

focuses.name: Timber for Leren Ships
focuses.desc: The eastern groves sell fallen timber to the shipwrights of the north. The elves cut nothing living, and the northerners learn to wait for the wind to do their felling.

focuses.name: The Elves Stand Apart
focuses.desc: The speakers write warmly to Sonargur and sign nothing. Trade is welcome, kindness is welcome, and a seat in any northern league is not.

focuses.name: The Eastern Woods
focuses.desc: The eastern woods are the federation's livelihood, and its first workshops rise where the woods are thickest and the rivers are near.

focuses.name: Resin and Timber
focuses.desc: Amber resin and dry timber are barrelled on the river quays and sold to all who ask. The groves lose nothing they would not have lost to the autumn.

focuses.name: Grove Roads
focuses.desc: Mossy tracks between the groves are widened and paved, so that a speaker may reach the moot in a day instead of three.

focuses.name: The Woods Prosper
focuses.desc: Craftsmen from five groves share their patterns, and the federation's workshops begin to turn out wares that no single grove could have made.

focuses.name: Kin of Andos Enda
focuses.desc: The Speaker sends gifts of resin and amber to the great forest and a promise that Andos Enda will not forget its kin.

focuses.name: Stand with the Kindred
focuses.desc: The Kindred of the Woods has been raised, and the Speaker lets the moot vote on it once. The vote is unanimous, which has never happened before.

focuses.name: Wanderers of Andos Enda
focuses.desc: Grove-healers and forest-wardens travel the roads as wanderers, answering the calls of strangers and asking no price.

focuses.name: The Refusal Remembered
focuses.desc: The moot recalls why the elves sent no armies after Edran's folly. Healers will go, hosts will not, and the federation will say so to anyone who asks.

focuses.name: Watch the Eastern Water
focuses.desc: The federation's woods face east, toward the rift. A chain of watchers is posted on the river heads and the eastern headlands, to see whatever comes over the water.

focuses.name: Shore Beacons
focuses.desc: Beacon stacks of resinous pine are raised on the eastern headlands and lit on the first sign of a strange keel.

focuses.name: Shore Levies
focuses.desc: Shore-folk are asked to keep bows by their doors and a rota of watchers on the river mouths. It is not a host, but it would answer if one were needed.

focuses.name: The Speakers' Wardens
focuses.desc: The wardens of the federation serve their groves first and the moot second. They are taught by the old foresters, who prize silence above speed and patience above both.

focuses.name: Longbows of Andos Enda
focuses.desc: The eastern bowyers cut yew from the oldest groves and string their bows with resin-waxed gut. Each stave is dated by the year its tree fell.

focuses.name: Grove Scouts
focuses.desc: Scouts of the eastern groves slip through the underbrush on nights without a moon. They carry shuttered lanterns, and signal in the old hand-speech of the woods.

focuses.name: The Federal Host
focuses.desc: On the Speaker's call the wardens of five groves assemble beneath the moot's green banner. A host of five voices, it seldom needs to be called.

focuses.name: The Federation Defends
focuses.desc: Strangers have crossed the eastern border in arms. The moot meets under the open sky, the horns sound in all five groves, and no seat is empty.

focuses.name: Hold the Eastern Groves
focuses.desc: Every grove is made a fortress. Barricades of thorn and fallen oak close the lanes, and archers take the high boughs.

focuses.name: The Kin Answer
focuses.desc: The kin of the neighbouring groves arrive without being called, bringing arrows, bread and a willingness to stand in the front rank.

focuses.name: Peace in the Woods
focuses.desc: The enemy is gone, the groves are whole and the moot meets again beneath the leaves. The Speaker reads the names of the fallen, and the moot sits in silence.
